host_observation.scope: Uncontrolled host observation; unrelated activity can affect it.

memory.scope: Concurrent monitor process tree, including its owned native worker and descendants, deduplicated by PID.
memory.excluded: Operating system, browser, unrelated processes and filesystem cache outside process residency; not whole-machine approval.
memory.rss_interpretation: Concurrent summed RSS may double-count shared pages.
memory.pss_interpretation: PSS apportions shared memory and is available only for complete readable samples.
memory.sampling_limit: Sequential process scans at 0.2-second intervals may miss transient peaks.
